reference.question: Find the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola \(y=2(x+3)^2-5\). Write the horizontal coordinate followed by the vertical coordinate (separated by a comma).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Identify h and k

\(y=2(x+3)^2-5\) can be written as \(y=2(x-(-3))^2+(-5)\), so \(h=-3\) and \(k=-5\). The vertex is \((-3,-5)\).
